notes.title: Reef cube — weekly water tests
notes.content:
Targets: alkalinity 8.5 dKH, calcium 400-440 ppm, nitrate under 10 ppm. Dosing rule: 5 ml buffer for every 0.1 dKH below the alkalinity target.
Week of Mar 3 — alkalinity 8.4 dKH, calcium 420 ppm, nitrate 8 ppm — dosed 5 ml buffer.
Week of Mar 10 — alkalinity 8.2 dKH, calcium 415 ppm, nitrate 9 ppm — dosed 15 ml buffer.
